description: This file implements the PidFd class and related functions for managing process file descriptors, including process launching, signal handling, and file descriptor management within the process sandboxing context.

classes.name: PidFd
classes.description: Represents a process file descriptor for a specific process, providing methods to interact with the process such as launching, retrieving file descriptors, signals, and process information.

methods.name: PidFd::FromRunningProcess
methods.description: Creates a PidFd object from a running process identified by its PID.

methods.name: PidFd::LaunchSubprocess
methods.description: Launches a subprocess with specified arguments, environment, and file descriptors, returning a PidFd for the new process.

methods.name: PidFd::Get
methods.description: Returns the underlying file descriptor for the process.

methods.name: PidFd::AllFds
methods.description: Retrieves all file descriptors associated with the process.

methods.name: PidFd::Argv
methods.description: Reads the command-line arguments of the process.

methods.name: PidFd::Env
methods.description: Reads the environment variables of the process.

methods.name: PidFd::HaltHierarchy
methods.description: Stops the process and its child hierarchy by sending signals.

methods.name: PidFd::SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to the process.
